title: Expand the skill user manual
summary: Describe the complete agent and reviewer flow, including initialization and repository changes.
rationale: The existing manual starts at the review UI and does not explain how the skill creates the artifact and commit stack that the UI consumes.

decisions.summary: Organize the manual as one end-to-end lifecycle with explicit repository effects.
decisions.rationale: Users need to know both which action comes next and whether it creates ignored state, an implementation commit, metadata, a branch, or archived history.

assumptions.statement: The coding agent normally runs the semantic-review commands while the human supplies requirements, feedback, and approvals.
assumptions.riskIfWrong: A user running the commands manually needs enough concrete examples to reproduce the same flow.

validation.summary: The manual names every lifecycle command and distinguishes active artifacts, ignored feedback, stage commits, metadata commits, PR-ready branches, and archived artifacts.
validation.command: git diff --check; CLI help checks; required workflow term check
